summary: Network Engineer at Tesco responsible for managing large enterprise networks, providing on-call support and consulting to developer teams.
responsibilities: Provide on-call support for Major incidents
Manage technical discussion with internal infra teams
Provide consultations to developer/App teams on network infra
required_skills: Network Skills: Juniper & Cisco Routing, Switching, Mist-Wireless, Zscaler (ZIA, ZPA), Forescout - NAC, Automation Silks - Python, API, Terraform, Jenkins, Ansible, CI/CD, GitLab, Resolve
Tools: Cisco ISE (Wi-Fi & radius) & Network perf monitoring tools SolarWinds etc.
nice_to_have_skills: Network Skills: Arista& Cisco Routing, Switching, F5 or any similar Load Balancing solution , Palo Alto
Automation Silks - Python, API, Terraform, Jenkins, Ansible, CI/CD, GitLab, Resolve
